feeds.title: ECAP Blog
feeds.description: Explore the ECAP blog for all your Texas Teacher certification questions and education. ECAP is an educator preparation program in Texas, specializing in facilitating certification for teachers in high-need areas such as Math, Science, and Bilingual. We have developed a very well-respected online and in-classroom training program that puts students ahead of the curve when it's time to hire.

feeds.title: The Texas OnCourse Educator Blog
feeds.description: Deciding what to do after high school and how to do it can be confusing. We're here to help. As a state-funded initiative to improve college and career readiness, our mission is to equip all Texas students for an educational and professional future that unlocks their potential. Texas OnCourse empowers you to make decisions that will help you, your child or your student succeed after high school.

feeds.title: Raise Your Hand Texas
feeds.description: Raise Your Hand Texas supports public policy solutions that invest in students, encourage innovation and autonomy, and improve college and workforce readiness. We believe the future of Texas, its economy, communities, and citizenry depends on how well we prepare our students today. We're reinventing public education for the future.

feeds.title: Texans Wake Up Blog
feeds.description: Texans Wake Up was started by a mother of two in the Texas Panhandle. She was alerted to what her child's class was reading in her local, public school when a community member made a post in a popular social media group. The mission of 'Texans, Wake Up' is to arm parents with the knowledge about what is occurring in public schools, provide support to handle these challenges through education and resources, and do our best to protect your family's conservative Christian values.

feeds.title: Educational Equity, Politics & Policy in Texas
feeds.description: This blog on Texas education by professor and researcher Angela Valenzuela contains posts on accountability, testing, college readiness, dropouts, bilingual education, immigration, school finance, race, class, and gender issues with additional focus at the national level.

feeds.title: HCDE News Blog
feeds.description: The blog articles provide insight from the education specialists at HCDE, including best practices and education innovation and reform discussions. HCDE is a unique, educational entity that serves school districts, government agencies, nonprofits, and the public.

feeds.title: Texas Council for the Social Studies Blog
feeds.description: Explore TXCSS news, reviews, updates, and surveys. Texas Council for the Social Studies ( TXCSS) represents social studies educators from across the state and serves as a voice on textbook and social studies issues. The purpose of this Organization is to improve the teaching of social studies and to encourage research, experimentation, and investigation in educational fields.

feeds.title: Education Week » Texas
feeds.description: Explore the latest happenings in the Texas education industry. Education Week is a top source of non-partisan, high-quality news, and insights covering the K-12 education sector. At Education Week, we believe that all children deserve a high-quality education. Guided by this vision, we make it our mission to empower the entire education community, from educators and policymakers to business leaders and beyond.

feeds.title: Teacher Builder Blog
feeds.description: Get ideas for building your teaching career. Teacher Builder is the first online alternative teacher certification program in South Texas to be approved by the State Board of Educator Certification (TEA). We certify candidates across Texas in over 25+ certification areas. We make it easy, efficient, and flexible for you to meet the state requirements by making the curriculum available to you.

feeds.title: Southern Careers Institute Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest posts and check out the full archive of career guides, education trends, and more on the Southern Careers Institute blog. Southern Careers Institute offers accelerated career training in Texas and online. Our purpose is to close the talent skills gap by elevating human capital and empowering individuals in new careers while adhering to the highest education and business standards.

feeds.title: Good Reason Houston
feeds.description: Check out the Good Reason Houston blog for relevant education discussions, data, current events, public school updates, and more. Good Reason Houston champions a bold, community-wide vision. They accelerate progress within districts and promote courageous decision-making to change the trajectory of school performance. Their mission is to increase the number of students learning in great public schools.

feeds.title: Breakthrough Central Texas Blog
feeds.description: Breakthrough Central Texas serves as a collaborative network of 24 affiliates throughout the U.S. by providing program standards and resources including curricula, evaluation tools, and teaching fellow recruitment. The mission is to build a path to college, starting in middle school, for low-income students who will be first-generation college graduates.

feeds.title: Teachers of Tomorrow Blog
feeds.description: At Texas Teachers, we pioneered the streamlined program that offers you the most effective route to the classroom. Our program and pricing are structured so that we are accountable for your success, therefore you can be assured that our professional team will be working hard for you each day.

feeds.title: The Shake Up Learning
feeds.description: The Shake Up Learning Blog by Kasey Bell offers tips and tricks, and tutorials to educators across the globe. At Shake Up Learning, we provide teachers with practical resources using today's technology. We'll share free resources, online courses, lesson plans, books, and so much more to inspire your students.

feeds.title: Math Coach's Corner Blog
feeds.description: Donna Bouche is a K-5 curriculum coordinator, co-author of the guided math workshop, and blogger at Math Coach's Corner. Her goal is to math fun and engaging for all students and ease the stress that some teachers associate with teaching math by providing highly interactive sessions and resources teachers can use.

feeds.title: Sweet Integrations
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sandy. I have been immersed in the evolution of technology as a teacher and as an Instructional Technology Specialist. My goal was always to teach students how to use technology effectively as a tool to enhance their learning. On my blog, I'll provide you with a wealth of technology tips, ideas for Project Based Learning, digital escape rooms, and resources for your classroom.

feeds.title: Texas Association for Alternative Education Blog
feeds.description: The Texas Association for Alternative Education is an association for alternative educators and related-field professionals. The Association is comprised of educators whose passion it is to serve students in nontraditional school settings such as disciplinary programs, juvenile justice programs, and others. The mission is to create a supportive network committed to providing quality education for all students.

feeds.title: Pre-K Pages Blog
feeds.description: I'm Vanessa Levin, an early childhood teacher, consultant, public speaker, and author. I have started the Pre-K Pages as a resource site for Pre-K and preschool teachers. Pre-K Pages offers printable lesson plans and playful learning themes for Preschool, Pre-K, and Kindergarten kids with fun hands-on activities.

feeds.title: Sarah Chesworth
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Sarah, I spent years in the classroom teaching Kindergarten and First Grade before deciding to stay home and focus on helping teachers and parents full-time. It's so special being able to live out both of my dreams. I started this blog as a way to share what was happening in my classroom and learn ideas with other teachers.
